verdict.rationale: stagewise gives you per-agent chat sessions where natural-language requests drive the agent to edit files, run shell commands, work with browser tabs and run multi-step workflows. A hands-on demo shows the agent acting on a plain-language request ("same height"), though it chose a hardcoded 298px value. The evidence covers natural-language control of coding work, not of the whole product. missing for 10: evidence that app-level operations (settings, workspace management, diff accept/reject) can be driven by natural language rather than UI controls, explicit first-party documentation of the natural-language chat interaction model, and independent corroboration that results from natural-language commands are reliably high quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Each agent has its own chat session and can use a different model.
Type / in the chat to see available commands from your skills and plugins.
The agent can read and edit files, run shell commands, interact with browser tabs via CDP, and orchestrate complex multi-step workflows.
In the demo video, the operator asks for "same height" and the agent sets a hardcoded 298px height
